resources.string: Clean-room Android IPTV and media player.\nSupports M3U/M3U8 playlists, HLS, DASH, and MP4 streaming via Media3.
This project does not include any proprietary credentials, private endpoints, or content from third-party APKs. Use only sources you own or are authorized to use.
Open-source components used under their respective licenses (AndroidX, Media3, Kotlin, OkHttp, Retrofit, Room, etc.).
